from.place: the lower bound in the proof of strict henselization dimension: faithful flatness and going down

title: Faithfully flat local maps do not lower Krull dimension
statement: Let $A$ and $B$ be local commutative rings and let $A\to B$ be a faithfully flat local ring homomorphism. Then $\dim A\le\dim B$, where dimension is Krull dimension [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring].

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00OH (lemma-dimension-going-up): going down and surjective Spec give dim R <= dim S; flat maps satisfy going down (Tag 00HS) and faithfully flat maps have surjective Spec
